decisions.decision: FilePress static site at temperpass.dev; no PocketBase or auth
decisions.rationale: No state needs to outlive the browser. Matches shelf sites (aiBreze, IngotVault).

decisions.decision: One repo holds skills (passes/) and the site (site/)
decisions.rationale: User asked for repo + site now.
Closest structural cousin is aiBreze. Patent grant matters more for ForgeTrail/IngotVault than for Markdown skills.

decisions.decision: Pass pages are flat FilePress slugs (/red-team), not /passes/[name]
decisions.rationale: FilePress pages are pages/<slug>.md only. Spec §9 nested path was written before this constraint was locked.

decisions.decision: Spec v4 copy is the source of truth for README and site
decisions.rationale: User asked that the mill and collection copy land as written. One source per string class.

decisions.decision: v1 install is copy-the-skill from this repo; do not announce npm until published
decisions.rationale: npm name temperpass is free (404) but unpublished. Advertising pnpm add would 404.

decisions.decision: Ship all four passes now; lock remaining three shortly
decisions.rationale: User: we will work on the other skills to refine and lock them shortly.

decisions.decision: Prune CRUD, auth, payments, and PocketBase exit criteria from tracking
decisions.rationale: Static content product. Archetype remains product.

decisions.decision: Drop /philosophy, /using, and a filtered pass index

gotchas.gotcha: FilePress adapter-static fails the build if there are zero posts: Routes marked prerenderable but not prerendered: /posts/[slug]. Ship at least one real post.
filepress check runs svelte-check against getfilepress package sources and reports dozens of node type errors. Not a site-content failure.
gotchas.fix: Treat pnpm site:build as the spine verification, not site:check, until the engine check is quiet.

gotchas.gotcha: clarify-first fired on 'the tests are flaky' when the gate lived only in the intro. Underspecified is not enough; undo cost must also be high.
gotchas.fix: Protocol step 0: both conditions, and do not announce a skip.

gotchas.gotcha: scope-lock invented HR nouns to fill a contract on 'hire a senior engineer.'
gotchas.fix: Step 1 forbids new nouns; if the one sentence cannot be written, stop.

gotchas.gotcha: tradeoff-matrix scored Railway vs Fly vs Render Postgres as three architectures.
gotchas.fix: Step 1: vendor/host/color for the same architecture is one option. Collapse and stop.

sessions.summary: Greenfield kickoff. Wrote project tracking and agent guardrails. Existing spec v4, red-team skill, and validation transcripts already in the folder.
User locked repo + site now. Brief written and locked. Scaffolding passes/, FilePress site, README from spec copy.
Origin story from Vox X post recorded. scope-lock and tradeoff-matrix locked with failed-run transcripts. clarify-first validated; step 0 added after a false trigger on a cheap flake question.
README and home now lead with the right-question thesis and the four passes; name and origin moved down. clarify-first added to site nav. License switched to MIT.

Masthead tagline now names the category (Expert skills for AI agents); hero leads with the claim. clarify-first step 4 revised: one question by default, a second only when independent and independently decision-changing, compound questions count as two. Recorded as P2 in examples/evals.

Headline changed to 'Judgment your agent can install.'; the old tagline now closes 'Why the name' verbatim. Nav collapsed to a single Passes entry backed by a new /passes index page. 'Wisdom' kept out of copy per overlay; 'tempered judgment' allowed as the brand phrase.

Headline is now 'Tempered judgment your agent can install.' aiBreze top-5 applied: flattened extra teaching contrasts, cut the setup sentence before the mill claim, dropped the hero triad, unpacked the tweet-waits pair on /clarify-first, aligned site description and /passes parked copy.

Review pass: meta description is now the shelf one-liner. theme.css restates light tokens under prefers-color-scheme: light so dark accent cannot leak onto parchment. Temper colors used on home, /passes, and the red-team sample. Spec §3/§6/§9 catch up to locked/validated status. LICENSE already MIT.
Logo is now a mill stand (header logo.svg + 32px favicon). Git remote set to Catalyst-Forge-LLC/temper-pass.
